dispatch_evidence.findings_summary: REFORMULATE. Core scrub-then-retest is sound and PROVEN: self-test 4/4; placeholder-only allowed, clean real key blocked, real-key-beside-placeholder blocked in BOTH scanners; overlap constructions (placeholder + appended chars) leak NO usable AWS key (every valid key needs its own AKIA prefix; scrub removes only exact placeholder occurrences); the set -e '|| true' fix is correct and necessary (proven: an unmasked no-match grep aborts under set -e; the real-key block still prints its banner, not an abort); default ALLOWLIST_VALUES and scrub semantics ARE in sync across both files; pre-commit SAFE_FILES exempts scanner files so their literals do not self-trip at commit time. NO Critical: under the shipped default config no real credential passes either scanner. TWO Major defects before land -- (1) pre-push does NOT content-exempt the scanner files (only pre-commit does), yet the new self-test embeds a real-shaped AKIA+16 fixture key in pre-push-scan.sh, so the push scanner BLOCKS pushing its own commit 08624a4c (PROVEN rc=1) -- this re-introduces the exact legitimate-push-block class the plan exists to eliminate. Fix: add pre-push-scan.sh|pre-commit|credential-push-blocked.sh to pre-push is_content_scan_exempt (mirror pre-commit SAFE_FILES), or synthesize the fixture key at runtime so no literal key lives in source. (2) The per-machine allowlist loader has no minimum-length or exact-value guard: a single short line (AKIA/A/sk-) silently disables an ENTIRE pattern class in BOTH scanners -- real credentials then pass with no warning (PROVEN). Fix: enforce a length floor (>=16) and/or exact-value semantics, and warn-to-stderr on skipped entries. Minor: the two loaders' comment-skip logic differs (regex vs case) and neither strips a trailing CR, so a CRLF local allowlist file silently fails to scrub on Windows.
